field_evidence.description: Erection of a part 5, part 6 storey building to create 5 self-contained flats (4 x 2 bed & 1x 1 bed) from 1st to 6th floor level, with ground floor cycle/refuse storage and an external fire escape to the rear.

rejection_reason: exact canonical_parcel_id and machine-extractable official distinct proposed/incomplete-building Polygon/MultiPolygon spatially bound to that canonical parcel; the official MHCLG Planning Data entity identifies a proposed part 5/part 6 storey building, but exposes geometry as blank and only a POINT, with no canonical parcel identifier or proposed-building footprint polygon
